title: Sources and Sinks
description: How energy moves from the sources to the sinks, and what that costs.

panels.title: Where the energy went — kWh over the range
panels.description: Energy flow over the dashboard range, in kWh. Solar that PG&E exported is split between the two arrays in proportion to what each produced that quarter-hour. Only quarter-hours where house load can be derived are counted; unknown stretches are left out, not zero.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / 900) * 900 AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / 900) * 900, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
              THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid END AS load
  FROM p
)
, f AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(main, 0) AS m, COALESCE(guest, 0) AS g, solar,
         MAX(-grid, 0) AS exp, MAX(grid, 0) AS imp
  FROM b WHERE load IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT source, target, ROUND(kwh, 3) AS kwh FROM (
  SELECT 'Main House Solar' AS source, 'House' AS target,
         SUM(m - CASE WHEN solar > 0 THEN exp * m / solar ELSE 0 END) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 AS kwh FROM f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Guest House Solar', 'House',
         SUM(g - CASE WHEN solar > 0 THEN exp * g / solar ELSE 0 END) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 FROM f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Main House Solar', 'Exported to PG&E',
         SUM(CASE WHEN solar > 0 THEN exp * m / solar ELSE 0 END) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 FROM f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Guest House Solar', 'Exported to PG&E',
         SUM(CASE WHEN solar > 0 THEN exp * g / solar ELSE 0 END) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 FROM f
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'PG&E Grid', 'House', SUM(imp) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 FROM f
) WHERE kwh > 0

panels.title: Balance — sources above, sinks below
panels.description: Above zero: what is supplying power. Below zero: where it is going. The two halves mirror each other exactly, because house load is derived as solar plus grid.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900), 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
              THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid END AS load
  FROM p
), ticks(t) AS (
  SELECT ($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) FROM ticks WHERE t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) < $__to / 1000
)
SELECT ticks.t AS time,
       b.main AS "Main House Solar",
       b.guest AS "Guest House Solar",
       MAX(b.grid, 0) AS "PG&E Grid import",
       -b.load AS "House",
       -MAX(-b.grid, 0) AS "PG&E Grid export"
FROM ticks
LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
ORDER BY 1

  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900), 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
              THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid END AS load
  FROM p
), ticks(t) AS (
  SELECT ($__from / 1000 / MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)) * MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) FROM ticks WHERE t + MAX(900, ($__interval_ms / 1000 / 900) * 900) < $__to / 1000
)
SELECT ticks.t AS time,
       b.main AS "Main House Solar",
       b.guest AS "Guest House Solar",
       MAX(b.grid, 0) AS "PG&E Grid import",
       -b.load AS "House",
       -MAX(-b.grid, 0) AS "PG&E Grid export"
FROM ticks
LEFT JOIN b ON b.t = ticks.t
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Daily cost estimate
panels.description: Import priced at the bill-derived time-of-use rates (4–9pm peak; summer $0.66 / $0.45, winter $0.625 / $0.571 per kWh), with export credited at the same rate for the hour it happened. An approximation of the energy charge only, not a bill. Always the last 30 days, whatever the dashboard range.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / 900) * 900 AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / 900) * 900, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
              THEN COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid END AS load
  FROM p
)
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', datetime(t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', 'start of day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN MAX(grid, 0) * (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0.66 ELSE 0.45 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0.625 ELSE 0.571 END) END) ELSE 0 END) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 AS "Import, 4–9pm",
       SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(grid, 0) * (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0.66 ELSE 0.45 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0.625 ELSE 0.571 END) END) END) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 AS "Import, off-peak",
       -SUM(MAX(-grid, 0) * (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%m', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 6 AND 9 THEN (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0.66 ELSE 0.45 END) ELSE (CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%H', t, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 16 AND 20 THEN 0.625 ELSE 0.571 END) END)) * 900 / 3600.0 / 1000.0 AS "Export credit"
FROM b WHERE load IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Typical day — solar, house and grid by hour
panels.description: Average power in each local hour. Always the last 30 days, whatever the dashboard range. Where solar stands above house load there is surplus to move flexible loads into; 16:00–20:00 are the peak-price hours.

WITH raw AS (
  SELECT (CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) / 900) * 900 AS t,
         so.slug AS slug,
         SUM(s.value * s.duration_s) / SUM(s.duration_s) AS w
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE se.metric IN ('production_w', 'demand_w')
    AND s.ts >= datetime(($__from / 1000 / 900) * 900, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), p AS (
  SELECT t,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'solaredge' THEN w END) AS main,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'envoy' THEN w END) AS guest,
         MAX(CASE WHEN slug = 'eagle' THEN w END) AS grid
  FROM raw
  GROUP BY t
), b AS (
  SELECT t, main, guest, grid,
         COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) AS solar,
         CASE WHEN grid IS NOT NULL
               AND (main IS NOT NULL OR COALESCE(guest, 0) < 20)
               AND COALESCE(main, 0) + COALESCE(guest, 0) + grid >= 0
